ارتعفنا (form VIII)
# اِرْتَعَفْنَا (irtaʕafnā) /ir.ta.ʕaf.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِرْتَعَفَ (irtaʕafa)
# اُرْتُعِفْنَا (urtuʕifnā) /ur.tu.ʕif.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِرْتَعَفَ (irtaʕafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
